run_app_reviews_preprocessing: run the AppReviews module to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_app_reviews_dataset: create an AppReviews instance to load the Hugging Face app_reviews dataset for regression tasks
build_train_test_split: build an 80/20 train/test split from the app_reviews dataset using a fixed random seed
map_hf_dataset_to_tuples: map a Hugging Face dataset split to a list of review text and star rating tuples
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot few-shot learning data from the AppReviews dataset for a given seed and k value
